documents.text: Newton's second law gives net force F = ma. A mass of 2 kg accelerating at 3 m/s² experiences 6 N of net force. Joules measure energy; newtons measure force.
Water formation follows 2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O. Two moles of hydrogen gas with excess oxygen yield two moles of water. The hydrogen-to-water molar ratio is 1:1.
In Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium p + q = 1 and heterozygote frequency is 2pq. If q = 0.2, p = 0.8 and heterozygote frequency is 0.32, or 32%.
Binary search requires a sorted array. It halves the search interval each step and runs in O(log n) time. Linear search runs in O(n) time and does not require sorted data.
